summary: This clinical trial compares a drug called tirzepatide against a breathing device called positive airway pressure for treating obstructive sleep apnoea. Obstructive sleep apnoea is a sleep disorder linked to being overweight or obese where breathing repeatedly stops and starts. The study plans to enroll 256 participants who are 18 years of age and older. Woolcock Institute of Medical Research is sponsoring this Phase 2/3 trial, which is currently Not yet recruiting.
